'''Drev Jalok''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] and owner of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Skyjumper]]'' which he operated with his [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] co-[[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Sullub Soonin]]. Jalok was ambushed en route to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altier]] by [[Drek Drednar]]'s [[Pirate/Legends|pirate band]]. After a short skirmish, Jalok surrendered to Drednar.
